instructions: Apply workflow/github-projects.md and templates/issue.md. Every card is a GitHub issue in the repository where the work happens, added to the single configured project; parent milestone with sub-issues. Status field with exactly open,pending,in-progress,in-review,rejected,blocked,completed,accepted,closed (never Done); Priority, Agent, Sprint, Due date and Completed at fields. Built-in workflows that move Status automatically stay disabled. Event log as LOG comments on the parent issue; evidence as sanitized files linked from the issue. No secrets in issues. Execution-finished differs from principal-verified completed and human accepted. Explicit legacy Kanban Markdown import mapping (backlog to open).
